comment: Generic extractor for extracting subtitles from various subtitle formats.

variables.name: STATE_EXTRACTING
variables.comment: The extractor is reading from the input and writing to the output.

variables.name: STATE_SEEKING
variables.comment: The extractor has received a seek() operation after it has already finished extracting.

variables.name: STATE_FINISHED
variables.comment: The extractor has finished extracting the input.

methods.name: public boolean sniff(ExtractorInput input) throws IOException
public int read(ExtractorInput input, PositionHolder seekPosition) throws IOException
public void seek(long position, long timeUs)
public void release()
methods.comment: Releases the extractor's resources, including the {@link SubtitleDecoder}.

methods.name: private boolean skipInput(ExtractorInput input) throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns whether the input has been fully skipped.

methods.name: private boolean readFromInput(ExtractorInput input) throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns whether reading has been finished.

methods.name: private void decode() throws IOException
methods.comment: Decodes the subtitle data and stores the samples in the memory of the extractor.
